scope: All official TCS families, all convex/metric geometry and combinatorics families, selected adjacent logic/probability/quantum/computability families, plus the earlier 2026 releases. Adjacent-subject relevance is editorial, not a claim that every mathematical family is TCS.
interpretation: A broader existing card counts as topic_present when the result is partial progress on that target. Missing_target includes related cards with different models, resources, logical directions or tasks. Coverage is by result family, not every companion theorem. No independent proof or full solvedness audit was performed.
archive_check: Searched the 6365 archived cards for likely counterparts to missing core TCS targets; WL archive entries concern other questions.
mutations: No cards, colors, categories, or service data changed.
